Do not exclude AGENTS.md; specs/agent-runtime/architecture-source.md, index.json, or index.md; docs/maintainers/technical-debt.md; tests/agent_migration_characterization.py; or any other src, docs, specs, or tests path.

taxonomy.rewrite_reference: Replace the exact active source text with its one-to-one moved owner.
taxonomy.rewrite_selector_data: Keep the dynamic import expression but rewrite all six exact lazy-owner selector values.
taxonomy.rewrite_consolidated_reference: Replace agent_pagination with pagination_completeness before deleting the old module.
taxonomy.no_migration_effect: Make no edit; the recorded basis proves the site is historical, a governance fact/evidence record, object-bound, deliberately retained, or outside the R17 selector domain.
taxonomy.runtime_verification_required: Run the bounded verification before migration; failure becomes a blocker.
taxonomy.blocker: Do not start R17 until the ownership or selector proposition is resolved.

classification_method.bare_agent_string: Classify each bounded Markdown record or JSON field: recognize consumer/current-path syntax before considering dated evidence, freeze only non-consumer dated decisions and explicit consolidated/deleted-module facts, rewrite active one-to-one paths, and block ambiguous deleted-module mentions.

classification_method.non_string_patch_expression: Separate object APIs from dotted-string APIs and inspect every finite producer/call domain.
classification_method.dynamic_import: Trace each expression to finite inputs; rewrite the root lazy selector and reject unknown domains.
classification_method.module_owner_receiver: Trace every receiver binding and retain only owners outside the R17 move set.
